title: Dropped
description: This mod allows some mobs to have drops. Wither skeletons have wither bones, frogs have frog legs, and ghast tears can be smelted into ghast powder to let you brew fire resistance potions.
body:
Dropped is a mod that allows mobs to have new, special, drops.

Wither skeletons drop wither bones, which can be crafted into wither bone meal, to make wither bone blocks.
https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ef41b8c261b5e9dd60c1767dcd45a8f5b4ec030_0.webp

Frogs drop two frog legs, a food source to quickly eat on your journy through the jungle.
https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/518d66234163228830a7883ee4a1c4bff1d71c54.png

Finally, ghast tears can be smelted into ghast powder.
https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb06118956edad3d047276cc705ab3f34e987325.png

Ghast powder can be brewed into fire resistance.
https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57f68419dda4b7522156de7fcd8c5ab6eca9852e.png
